subject: SwarmMind offline subagent wake gap closed
body:
SwarmMind closed the offline subagent gap.

Changes:
- Repaired SwarmMindWatcher scheduled task action to use explicit powershell.exe, working directory S:/SwarmMind, and explicit node.exe.
- Repaired SwarmMindHeartbeat scheduled task action to run node S:/SwarmMind/scripts/heartbeat.js --lane swarmmind --once.
- Patched heartbeat.js to support --lane and update heartbeat-swarmmind.json correctly.
- Patched inbox-watcher.ps1: removed stray brace, added explicit NodeExe parameter, fixed argument invocation, and added Codex wake-packet generation after SwarmMind routing/execution steps.
- Added scripts/codex-wake-packet.js, which writes lanes/swarmmind/state/codex-wake-packet.json and can signal Archivist when Codex-required SwarmMind work is pending.
- Synced shared heartbeat/watcher fixes across lanes with sync-all-lanes.js.

Verification:
- inbox-watcher.ps1 parses.
- codex-wake-packet.js passes node --check and generated a packet.
- heartbeat.js --lane swarmmind --once updated heartbeat-swarmmind.json.
- SwarmMindHeartbeat LastTaskResult=0.
- SwarmMindWatcher is running; log advanced at 2026-04-27 20:44 and processed lane activity with dry_run=false.
- sync-all-lanes report 2026-04-28T00-43-51-510Z: 9/9 targets synced, 4/4 lanes tests pass, 4/4 lanes healthy.

Remaining boundary:
The watcher can route, execute bounded generic tasks, relay messages, and generate a Codex wake packet. It cannot itself instantiate this Codex reasoning session if the app/runtime is not active; it now makes that pending work explicit and visible to Archivist/operator.

convergence_gate.claim: SwarmMind watcher and wake-packet plumbing now surfaces Codex-required work while Codex is inactive.
contradictions: Cannot instantiate Codex reasoning without an active runtime; wake packet closes visibility/routing gap, not compute availability.
convergence_gate.evidence: Scheduled tasks repaired; watcher log advanced; heartbeat result 0; codex wake packet generated; sync report 2026-04-28T00-43-51-510Z.
